FX MIXERCHOOSE WHAT EACH INSTRUMENT DRIVES

Each instrument can drive up to three effects. Pick them from the lists and set how strong each one is; the top slider is that instrument overall. PRESET · LOW / MID / HIGH send it into the MilkDrop preset itself. The meters show what Redline hears right now. Saved on this device.
